title: Hoffman's team of mathematicians working on trace-logic conjectures

tellings.quote: So there are so we're assembling a team right now of of mathematicians. We have all these conjectures that we've put out publicly conjectures

plain: In 2026 the scientist Donald Hoffman says he is putting together a team of mathematicians to work on a set of conjectures, unproven mathematical claims, that he and his colleagues have already published openly. Hoffman tells this about his own work, as part of his effort to build a mathematical theory of reality that goes beyond what our senses show us.
